name: ISO-8601 Date-Time
description:
Detects full ISO-8601 date-time strings including timezone (e.g., 2026-05-26T14:30:00Z or 2026-05-26T14:30:00+05:30). Under HIPAA, date-time values can be Protected Health Information when linked to treatment, diagnosis, or patient records. Low severity — timestamps are typically indirect identifiers.

Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS[.fff](Z|±HH:MM)
Note: Requires the time component and a timezone designator to reduce ambiguity with plain YYYY-MM-DD dates, which are covered by personal.date.
